subject: Invitation to our Annual Company Gala
body: Dear Team, We are excited to invite you to our Annual Company Gala on Friday, November 12th. Join us for an evening of celebration, networking, and fun! The event will feature a gourmet dinner, live entertainment, and awards ceremony. Dress code is black tie. Please RSVP by October 30th. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Company Name] Events Team
